methodology: Three serial repetitions per renderer/workload, rotating renderer order; 240x80 cells/DPR1/shared font. Warmed synchronous cores with precomputed eight-variant input; parse+draw included, scheduler disabled. GPU throughput fences every32 submissions plus final fence. DOM CPU time includes parse+render+forced layout, not compositor paint. WebGL throughput headline rounds DOWN slowest Wraith / fastest xterm WebGL. DOM CPU headline rounds DOWN fastest xterm DOM p50 / slowest Wraith p50. Short synthetic bursts, not display FPS, public worker throughput or universal speed. Capturing and video rendering paused during measurement; unrelated desktop processes may run. Visible text and canvas geometry match; glyph/style pixels are only a nonblank/color sanity check.
